content: {"praised":["Emotional, unforgettable experience with powerful, tear‑jerking moments.","Masterpiece with strong themes of second chances and noble deeds.","Nuanced acting, especially Sidse Babett Knudsen’s performance.","Beautiful visuals and natural lighting reminiscent of Dogme style.","Engaging, well‑crafted story that resonates with audiences."],"criticized":["Story is maudlin, predictable, and unbelievable.","Direction sloppy, plodding, and loses focus.","Handheld camera overused, causing distracting close‑ups.","Near gibberish, pacing drags after initial hook.","Tone shifts abruptly, ending feels unsatisfying."]}
